metaDescription: Carolina Dog vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Carolina Dog boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The Carolina Dog core series (DA2PP / DHPP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a medium puppy is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 30-65 lb (14-29 kg), Carolina Dog visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring dental disease and parasite exposure if free-roaming history into the Carolina Dog exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.
Rabies for a Carolina Dog still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Carolina Dog boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Carolina Dog row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Carolina Dog item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Carolina Dog kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Carolina Dog due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Carolina Dog core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Carolina Dog misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Carolina Dog health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Carolina Dog adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
